context: Generate a deterministic migration plan from the canonical anonymizer, record before/after hashes and any result-ID mapping, validate every rewritten bundle and companion, regenerate inventory/read-model outputs, and land develop and published-results changes through their normal reviewed PR paths. Preserve benchmark measurements and provenance semantics exactly; only identifying path values and dependent hashes may change.
description: After the public path-privacy contract is enforced, migrate the existing curated corpus and the published-results branch so no downloadable bundle carries a machine-local path. The review measured 183 affected bundles at 17c0c098a. Because bundle and manifest hashes, result IDs, companion references, trust labels, and historical links may be content-derived, this is a controlled data migration rather than a search-and-replace.

anti_patterns.dont: declare success from the source-tree scan alone
anti_patterns.instead: scan both branches and a freshly built public/data/bundles output
anti_patterns.why: the Explorer publishes transformed copies and the published-results branch is a separate source

anti_patterns.dont: hand-edit hundreds of JSON files or use an unreviewed regex replacement
anti_patterns.instead: use the canonical anonymizer in a deterministic migration tool with a reviewed change manifest
anti_patterns.why: manual mutation can alter measurements, miss nested paths, and desynchronize hashes

anti_patterns.dont: preserve an old digest or result ID after changing bytes unless the contract explicitly defines it as content-independent
anti_patterns.instead: recompute dependent identifiers and update every reference with an auditable mapping
anti_patterns.why: that would turn evidence identity into a lie

preserves.behavior: Any changed result ID has an explicit old-to-new mapping and all internal references are migrated atomically.
Content hashes and manifests are recomputed honestly after content changes; stale hashes are never retained to make the diff smaller.
Develop and published-results are changed through separate reviewed PRs; neither protected branch is pushed directly.
Every timing, query status, benchmark/platform/scale/phase value, trust label, funding value, and ranking-eligibility decision remains semantically unchanged.
The last known-good corpus and a machine-readable migration manifest remain recoverable until the new public snapshot is accepted.

prior_art.concept: Use the newly hardened public anonymizer as the sole value transformation.
Reuse deterministic corpus discovery and summary generation after migration.
Validate migrated bundle/manifest pairs with the same contract applied to future submissions.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'import json,re; from pathlib import Path; ps=list(Path("results-data/bundles").rglob("*.json")); bad=[str(p) for p in ps if re.search(r"(?:/Users/|/home/|[A-Za-z]:\\Users\\)", json.dumps(json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))))]; assert not bad, f"{len(bad)} files still expose home paths"'
verifications.description: No curated bundle or manifest contains a private home path
verifications.expected: Fails on the unfixed corpus; exits 0 after every migrated bundle and manifest is clean.
